edges.mechanism: EVOO-rich MedDiet lowers diastolic BP (~1.5 mmHg) and phenolic olive oils lower SBP (~3 mmHg vs refined oil); concentrated olive phenol extract lowered SBP 7.7 mmHg; additive BP lowering possible.
edges.evidence: PREDIMED RCT, network MA, single extract RCT; no direct interaction study; low certainty

edges.mechanism: EVOO lowers postprandial glucose (incretin/GLP-1, slowed gastric emptying) and reduced insulin requirement in gestational diabetes; olive phenol extract lowered FBG/HbA1c; additive glucose lowering possible.
edges.evidence: Crossover meal studies, RCT in GDM (n=190), extract RCT; no hypoglycaemia reports; low certainty

edges.mechanism: Possible additive glucose lowering via EVOO/olive phenol effects on postprandial and fasting glucose; no direct metformin study.
edges.evidence: Inferred from glycaemic RCTs; very low certainty

edges.mechanism: EVOO supplementation reduced the need for insulinization in gestational diabetes (RR 0.595) and lowers postprandial glycaemia in type 1 diabetes on pump therapy.
edges.evidence: RCT (n=190) and crossover (n=11); low certainty

edges.mechanism: Olive phenols have antiplatelet activity; olive oil intake associated with lower thromboxane in VKA-treated AF patients. MedDiet (90% olive oil users) did not change INR time in therapeutic range.
edges.evidence: Observational AF cohorts and PREDIMED secondary analysis; no warfarin potentiation case found; low certainty

edges.mechanism: Olive oil phenols inhibit platelet aggregation (cAMP-PDE inhibition) and olive oil intake independently predicts lower urinary 11-dehydro-TxB2; theoretical additive antiplatelet effect.
edges.evidence: In vitro human platelets plus observational cohort; no bleeding signal; very low certainty

edges.mechanism: Additive antiplatelet effect theoretically possible from olive phenols; no clinical bleeding signal reported.
edges.evidence: In vitro and observational only; very low certainty

edges.mechanism: Olive oil added to fish oil (3 g/d) gave earlier and greater clinical improvement in rheumatoid arthritis than fish oil alone.
edges.evidence: Single small RCT (n=43); low certainty

edges.mechanism: Olive oil as dietary fat increases lycopene absorption (plasma trans-lycopene +82% when tomatoes cooked with EVOO; lycopene iAUC +46% vs coconut oil).
edges.evidence: Small human feeding/crossover trials; moderate certainty for absorption

edges.mechanism: Co-ingested fat improves carotenoid absorption and olive oil beat coconut oil for total carotenoids; however, saturated fats gave higher lutein/zeaxanthin bioavailability than olive oil in rat/in vitro models.
edges.evidence: Human crossover plus animal/in vitro data; conflicting; low certainty

edges.mechanism: Olive-oil-based excipient emulsions gave the greatest curcumin trans-enterocyte transport and protection from metabolism among oils tested.
edges.evidence: Caco-2 in vitro only; very low certainty

edges.mechanism: Olive oil pinoresinol reduced intestinal vitamin D absorption (-25% postprandial response in rats; Caco-2 uptake inhibited).
edges.evidence: Animal and cell data only; human relevance unknown; very low certainty

edges.mechanism: Phenolic EVOO plus FOS/inulin prebiotic increased rectus femoris muscle thickness/CSA more than EVOO alone in older adults with probable sarcopenia.
edges.evidence: Small 3-arm RCT (n=38); low certainty

edges.mechanism: Rare IgE-mediated olive fruit allergy (pollen-food olive-olive syndrome); refined oil challenge was tolerated in the reported case.
edges.evidence: Case report; very low certainty

edges.mechanism: Chronic aspiration of olive oil can cause exogenous lipoid pneumonia.
edges.evidence: Case report (2026); very low certainty

edges.mechanism: Olive oil is a potent gallbladder-contraction stimulus (used as cholecystokinetic test meal, peak at 50-70 min).
edges.evidence: Crossover diagnostic trial (n=112); mechanistic precaution only

edges.mechanism: EVOO is energy dense (~9 kcal/g); in PREDIMED an ad libitum high-fat MedDiet did not raise body weight, but added rather than substituted oil increases energy intake.
edges.evidence: Large RCT secondary outcome; moderate certainty for no weight gain

edges.mechanism: EVOO (3 tbsp/d) reduced triglycerides, insulin requirement and neonatal complications; glucose-lowering therapy may need review.
edges.evidence: RCT (n=190); low certainty

edges.mechanism: MedDiet (EVOO or nuts) abolished the excess stroke risk (HR 2.91 on control diet) and the higher glucose/lipids of TT homozygotes.
edges.evidence: PREDIMED gene-diet interaction analysis; low certainty

edges.mechanism: Olive oil ingestion itself triggers gallbladder contraction and is used as the test stimulus; recent oil intake before fasting gallbladder ultrasound could alter baseline volume.
edges.evidence: Diagnostic trial; inferred precaution
